name: 3rdtimeisthecharm
description: 3rdtimeisthecharm, aka 3TITC. Iteratively IMPROVE / REFINE / TIGHTEN / POLISH a PROMPT (or any artifact) by getting a SECOND OPINION from a ChatGPT session (driven via Claude-in-Chrome) on the current state plus a user-given improvement DIRECTION, then JUDGING that feedback with your own repo/doctrine context and adopting ONLY the sensible points, up to 3 rounds, until a passing grade (default 9.0/10). Triggers on: improve this prompt, refine / tighten / sharpen wording, make a prompt or copy SHORTER / more CONCISE / more impactful, optimize a prompt, prompt optimization, review and revise, score and improve, get a second opinion on a prompt, run it by ChatGPT, iterate a prompt with ChatGPT, refine-until-good. Core discipline: the outside model is CONTEXT-BLIND, so its feedback is INPUT not orders — you accept only what survives your judgement and reject cosmetic churn; if the state isn't stably visible, build a surface to extract it first; loop stops when the score clears the (arbitrary but guarded) passing bar. Always use ChatGPT's smartest model. REQUIREMENTS GATE: before looping, confirm BOTH the subject (which prompt/artifact to improve) and the direction (what 'better' means); if either is missing or vague, clarify with the user first — never guess the subject or invent a direction.
author: GuildOS
